description: Na₂Zn₂O₃ is Ilmenite-like structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal P4_32_12 space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O²⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.43 Å. Zn²⁺ is bonded to four O²⁻ atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ZnO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Zn-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.07 Å. There are two inequivalent O²⁻ sites. In the first O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Zn²⁺ atoms. In the second O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and three equivalent Zn²⁺ atoms to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₃Zn₃ octahedra.
